Other platforms also manage to shove dynamic bone calculations on other threads entirely, somehow. I don't know if that's an option here.

details:
This would make you able to touch others people's hair, clothes, etc. 
It should be an option to enable bones that are "dynamic bones" to be touched by other people's "dynamic bone colliders". 
Some people would not want to be touched by random people though, so it could have the three options: 
Everyone, friends or none, where it starts at none by default.
title: Enable interaction with friends dynamic bones
